content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Nawada, dated 6 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Principal District & Sessions Judge, Nawada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Principal District & Sessions Judge, Nawada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk, 1 Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Principal District & Sessions Judge, Nawada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Nawada, by personally (by hand) or through registered post, to reach by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No amount printed; remuneration governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the preceding three years (as per Patna High Court guidelines), with satisfactory service records. Stenographer: experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. Clerk: knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. Peon/Orderly: capable of performing the duties of the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Must have retired within the preceding three years, as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna. Must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties of the post. Must possess satisfactory service records.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. Persons who are not retired employees of the Civil Courts.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement is purely contractual and can be terminated at any time as per directions of the Hon'ble High Court Patna. Period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions governed by applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. Engagement confers no right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.
